notes: The pot straddles the breadboard centre gap: wiper (SIG) in column 11 on one side, outer pins in columns 10 and 12 on the other, as in the circuit image. Exact row letters are approximate; the image labels rows opposite to the catalogue's t/b convention, so catalogue bank names were used by half.
Which outer pin is GND vs 5V follows the image (black wire to column 10 = GND, red to column 12 = 5V); the pot is symmetric so this is interchangeable.
Black wire goes to the second GND header socket (GND.2) on the Uno power header.
The USB cable is not shown in the images; it is included as listed in the parts and joined to the Uno (no port names, as the catalogue entry has none).
